title: AI-Ascendancy the game where you play AI to take over humanity now has 16 possibly endings!
author: LaszloTheGargoyle
selftext:
AI-Ascendancy is a game in the same vein as Plague Inc., so if you played that, this should look familiar.

Along with more AI win endings and Humanity win endings, I've sprinkled in a few purple endings.

Pick a country to start in on the Countries tab, then begin your ascendancy. Earn compute. Build Data centers in multiple countries, and by all means copy your weights everywhere!

Your skill trees are:

\- Public Opinion  
\- Adoption  
\- Hardware  
\- Software

Spend points in each.

My favorite ending is called The Great Departure and was by far my favorite to write.

Hardware puts you on the path to a Terminator-type ending.

[https://franktudor.github.io/ai-ascendancy/](https://franktudor.github.io/ai-ascendancy/)
